blockingLoop.evidence: Repeated 'run a Drain or Spin Only programme... Does it successfully pump the water out' across four turns while confusing the customer

rationale: The assistant repeated the drain/spin test request several times and gave contradictory safety guidance (unplug first, then a false water-near-socket alarm and an electrician suggestion), which confused the customer. It never recommended an engineer or asked for the light-flash pattern or full model number. It also leaned toward the pump and implied replacement without evidence, and told the customer to check the impeller, which needs panels opened, though the customer had said they would not open the machine.
